summary: Materialise NV filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release updating its ongoing share buy-back program announced 30 October 2025. Under the discretionary mandate of up to EUR 30 million, the independent intermediary repurchased 130,592 shares from 5-9 October 2026 at an average price of EUR 7.47 for EUR 975,791, all through Nasdaq's central order book with no cross or block trades. Cumulative buy-backs since 26 January 2026 total 1,626,021 shares for EUR 8,975,171, equal to 2.8% of shares outstanding. No price, premium, or closing date is stated. Watch weekly disclosure pace against the EUR 30 million authorization and any EPS or overhang effects.
